weles._comment: Weles through weles-mcp. Without Weles replace browser.weles with browser.playwright_mcp: command and args, the program that starts the Playwright MCP server and its arguments.

brama._comment: Brama (org model router). Its address comes from Stado's service directory; set url only to override it. Without Brama replace models.brama with models.openai_compatible: url, bearer and model of any OpenAI-compatible provider.
